notes.title: Candice 9th Anniversary 480i Remaster
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-BR0NGUtU6k;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetingz fanz of vanz, tanz & granz,


Az we r coming up 2 my 9th anniversary on da Steam, I thought it rite and propa 2 get myself a few tweakmentz done 4 myself. So in celebration I also updated my first game 2 bring it up 2 date & keep it relevant!


 Animated jiggle physics for my jiggly jiggly hair
 Completely reworked the game's lighting and shadows
 Many texture improvements
 Better dialogue boxes
 In-game reconfigurable keyboard controls
 Improvements to Steam Input integration and Steamdeck support
 Improvements to many weapons
 Improved battle GUI
 Better grass & trees
 Superior walking and running animation
 Return to Title Screen button in menu


It iz now az beautiful az any game from 2005 cud eva expect 2 be, & I hope itz beauty reflectz back on all of u, my fanz.

Az a special treat, I am also on sale 4 a bit.

Thank u all my fanz - I luv u all & I wud hav nuthing without u. Except from fantastic new animated hair obviously xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

notes.title: Candice DeBébé 720p Remaster
notes.content:
My dearest fans,

I felt it was tym 4 a bit of a spruce 4 myself, so I went 2 the Brandi Sisters 3 & got myself a full make over!

The new update of Candice DeBébé's Incredibly Trick Lifestyle takez ur existing beloved Candice experience & completely upgradez it 2 make it fully st8 of the art. 

Diss includes:


 New close-up chat camera (see screnshot), and facial animation including lipsync 4 most major characterz
 New MP system for special abilities, & enhancements 2 all special abilitiez
 Fast-travel portals 2 avoid backtracking
 Maps 4 the Digital Hex levelz
 Other gameplay & graphix tweaks & twerkz


Honestly my game haz been reborn like a phoenix, & iz well worth a replay as it iz now a phenomenal & a half tym.

With all my candid luve,

Candice xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

notes.title: Tricker than Ever
notes.content:
I iz delited 2 anounce anutha magical Candice update!!!

Amongst many tweaks & twerkz, if u boot urself up the latest & gr8est update, u will find:

* Mermaid tailz hav been extensivly reworked 2 make them more paaahful & more reliable
* Improvementz 2 da Digital Hex weppon
* Da top of Challenge Mountain haz had itz gravity altered, & the exit better signalled

Honestly I can nt beleve it either bt my game iz ageing like fine wine & is now classier than ever 

Much love,

Candice xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx x x

notes.title: Even more updatez!!!
notes.content:
Dearest Hunnerati,

Go on giv it a try it is sensational

With all of my luv,

Candice xxxxxxxxx

notes.title: Updatez
notes.content:
My dearest hunz,

I kno u havnt heard from me in a wile but dnt think I hav nt been busily working away at Candice! I hav, & I am pleased 2 announce a few trick updates I hav dun:

* I hav invented running. Diss has added a hole new dimension  2 da game, & da enemiez hav been rebalanced 2 compensate

* Digital Hex now haz a navigation feature 2 make it easier xx

* Da mouse & keyboard features hav been improved, such that tha camera only movez if da rite mouse button is held down, jst like a real computer rpg innit


Wiv all my luv,

Candice xx
